#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <set>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const double PREC = 1e-10;

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}

    Point sub(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }

    Point add(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x + other.x, y + other.y);
    }

    Point mul(double f) const {
        return Point(x * f, y * f);
    }

    Point div(double f) const {
        return Point(x / f, y / f);
    }

    Point normalize() const {
        double len = sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        return div(len);
    }

    Point getAlpha() const {
        return Point(-y, x);
    }

    Point moveAlongVector(const Point& vec, double length) const {
        return add(vec.normalize().mul(length));
    }

    Point moveAlongLine(const class Line& line, double length) const;

    bool operator<(const Point& other) const {
        if (fabs(x - other.x) >= PREC) return x < other.x;
        if (fabs(y - other.y) >= PREC) return y < other.y;
        return false; // equal
    }
};

struct Line {
    Point from, to;
    Line(const Point& from, const Point& to) : from(from), to(to) {}

    Point asVector() const {
        return to.sub(from);
    }

    double length() const {
        return distance(from, to);
    }
};

Point Point::moveAlongLine(const Line& line, double length) const {
    return moveAlongVector(line.asVector(), length);
}

double distance(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    return sqrt(distance2(a, b));
}

double distance2(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    double dx = a.x - b.x;
    double dy = a.y - b.y;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy;
}

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    int r;
    Circle() : center(), r(0) {}
    Circle(int x, int y, int r) : center(x, y), r(r) {}

    static bool isIntersect(const Circle& a, const Circle& b) {
        double d = distance(a.center, b.center);
        return d <= a.r + b.r + PREC && d + PREC >= fabs(a.r - b.r);
    }

    static bool isIntersect2(const Circle& a, const Circle& b) {
        double d = distance(a.center, b.center);
        return d < a.r + b.r && d > fabs(a.r - b.r);
    }

    static void intersectAt(const Circle& a, const Circle& b, set<Point>& set) {
        if (!isIntersect(a, b)) return;
        Line line(a.center, b.center);
        double d = distance(a.center, b.center);
        if (d < PREC) return; // concentric circles, no distinct intersection points
        double middleDistance = (d * d - b.r * b.r + a.r * a.r) / (2 * d);
        Point middle = a.center.moveAlongLine(line, middleDistance);
        Point alpha = line.asVector().getAlpha();
        double height = sqrt(a.r * a.r - middleDistance * middleDistance);
        Point first = middle.moveAlongVector(alpha, height);
        Point second = middle.moveAlongVector(alpha, -height);
        set.insert(first);
        set.insert(second);
    }
};

void solve() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int x, y, r;
        cin >> x >> y >> r;
        circles[i] = Circle(x, y, r);
    }

    if (n == 3 && !Circle::isIntersect(circles[0], circles[1])) {
        int sum = 4;
        if (Circle::isIntersect2(circles[0], circles[2])) sum++;
        if (Circle::isIntersect2(circles[1], circles[2])) sum++;
        cout << sum << endl;
        return;
    }

    int total = 1;
    set<Point> pointSet;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        pointSet.clear();
        total++;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            Circle::intersectAt(circles[i], circles[j], pointSet);
        }
        if (pointSet.size() >= 2) {
            total += pointSet.size() - 1;
        }
    }
    cout << total << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
